tools.name: quote_travel_esim
tools.description: Find current Simcardo eSIM plans for a dated trip. Use when the traveler needs a plan that covers a destination, trip duration, data allowance or tethering requirement. Return verified matches with total price, activation terms and a direct product link, or explain why no plan can be confirmed.

tools.name: list_esim_destinations
tools.description: Discover countries, territories and regional/global packages. Coverage-only territories have no dedicated storefront. Returns active languages, counts, localized names and canonical links where available. Paginate with next_after_market. Use quote_travel_esim for dates and hotspot.

tools.name: list_esim_plans
tools.description: Browse every current public plan, optionally by country/territory market (e.g. JP), package slug (e.g. europe-extra), or exact SKU. Returns localized links, retail total, coverage codes, validity and supplier facts, including explicit unknowns. Browse results are not travel recommendations; use quot
